wedding-places-01.title: Choosing a place of honor
wedding-places-01.alt: A dark-bearded guest in blue rests his hand on a prominent patterned cushion while a younger guest in brown attends to a lower place beside the table and an older host stands behind.
wedding-places-01.caption: Jesus notices how guests choose places of honor and teaches them about humility. This imagined wedding gathering introduces the contrast between seeking prominence and taking a lower place.
